$comment: Gzip budgets for `pnpm size` (scripts/size.ts). Each export subpath of each package is built on its own (svelte external) and its initial JavaScript is measured with gzip -9; cssGzip is the CSS it emits. Exact ids win over `<package>/*` patterns. Budgets only shrink: `pnpm size --update` tightens them, and only `--update --allow-grow` (with a reason in the report) raises one. A `protoyard` baseline is the Protoyard package the entry replaces; the entry may not be larger (`pnpm size --protoyard <checkout>` re-measures it).
